korean_vocabulary.txt is derived from the full Korean list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave
(https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords, content/2018/ko/ko_full.txt), licensed under
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0,
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). Changes: only words
of two or more Hangul syllables seen at least twice were kept, with their counts
(tools/build_korean_vocabulary.py).
korean_vocabulary.txt itself is distributed under the same license, CC BY-SA 4.0.

norwegian_words.txt is derived from the full Norwegian list of FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave
(https://github.com/hermitdave/FrequencyWords, content/2018/no/no_full.txt), under the same
license. Changes: lowercased words of the letters a–z, æ, ø, å seen at least five times were kept,
their frequency rank turned into a level from 10 to 60 (tools/build_norwegian_words.py).
norwegian_words.txt itself is distributed under the same license, CC BY-SA 4.0.
